description: 10 individual LEDs in one package, each with its own anode/cathode pair (A1/C1 through A10/C10).
how_to_use: Each LED segment is independent — its anode (`AN`) and cathode (`CN`) are only that one LED's pins, not shared with any other segment, and not interchangeable with a different segment's pins (each drives a specific position in the bar).

plain.what: Ten LEDs side by side in one package — great for a level meter.
plain.how: Put it across the middle gap. Each bar has its own + leg (on the printed side) and − leg: + to an Arduino pin, − through a 220 Ω resistor to GND.

pins.A1: bar 1's + leg (A2…A10 the same for the others)
